title: Argentina, Spain and their stars Lionel Messi and Lamine Yamal meet in World Cup final
description: Worry no more about wildfire smoke and $10,000 ticket prices. Sunday's final between Argentina and Spain — the first meeting of their transcendent stars — is here and seems destined to be a classic.

title: Spanish legend Joan Capdevila will be allowed to enter the US for World Cup final after ban for Iran visit: sources
